title: Silicon: push one atom along a Si–Si bond

sourceProvenance.notes: a = 5.431 Å is an input chosen close to the experimental room-temperature value.

structure.periodicImages: positions are never wrapped; the moved atom keeps its index in every frame; edges use the minimum-image shifts computed by the MACE neighbour list

displacement.definition: r_moved(d) = r_moved(0) + d·û, all other atoms fixed; d > 0 shortens the bond to the partner atom

provenance.rounding: energies full float64; forces, site energies and positions to 1e-7; features 5 significant figures (frames) and change norms 4; |x| < 1e-12 written as 0
